title: GraphBEAT: Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation Over Time for Early Risk Stratification of Gastrointestinal Cancers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) contain complementary diagnostic and laboratory information about patient health. However, irregularity, sparsity, heterogeneity, and incompleteness in documentation complicate EHR modeling. To address the problem, we introduce GraphBEAT (Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation over Time), a temporal graph representation learning framework that groups clinical events into time buckets and transforms observed features into patient-specific, temporally directed graphs to enable early risk stratification for gastrointestinal cancers. Each node in an EHR graph encodes feature identity, observed value, and temporal position of clinical events. A context-aware, time-decay message-passing mechanism models transitions between successive buckets, followed by multi-head attention pooling to generate patient-level representations. translated_title: GraphBEAT：基于图的分桶事件时间聚合框架，用于胃肠道癌症的早期风险分层
translated_abstract: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）包含关于患者健康的互补性诊断与实验室信息。然而，文档记录的不规则性、稀疏性、异质性和不完整性使EHR建模变得困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GraphBEAT（基于图的分桶事件时间聚合），这是一个时序图表示学习框架，它将临床事件按时间分桶分组，并将观察到的特征转换为患者特定的、时间有向的图，从而实现胃肠道癌症的早期风险分层。EHR图中的每个节点编码临床事件的特征标识、观察值和时间位置。一种上下文感知且具有时间衰减机制的消息传递方法建模相邻时间桶之间的转换，随后通过多头注意力池化生成患者级别的表示。GraphBEAT在多站点纵向诊断数据上进行了训练和评估。
tldr: 提出GraphBEAT时序图表示学习框架，将纵向EHR临床事件转化为按时间分桶的患者特定有向图，结合时间衰减消息传递与多头注意力池化，实现胃肠道癌症的早期风险分层。
en_tdlr: GraphBEAT is a temporal graph representation learning framework that transforms longitudinal EHR clinical events into time-bucketed, patient-specific directed graphs with time-decay message passing and multi-head attention pooling, enabling early risk stratification of gastrointestinal cancers.
